tagline: Where every friend has a home and every day is a small adventure.

members.name: Taffy
members.personality: the bouncy, brave bunny who turns every puddle into a party

members.name: Ben
members.personality: the big, warm bear who squeezes every worry away with a hug

members.name: Daisy
members.personality: the sunny duck who sings about everything and paddles everywhere

members.name: Fiona
members.personality: the fast, clever fox who races Taffy and Ben at the Sunny Meadow Games — and always high-fives everyone after

members.name: Grandpa Tilly
members.personality: the gentle grandpa turtle who tells wonderful stories and knows that slow and steady wins the day

members.name: Professor Ozzy
members.personality: the wise owl who runs the Sunny Meadow schoolhouse and loves asking questions even more than he loves answering them

rules: Only these animals live in Sunny Meadow. A story NEVER introduces a new species — every party guest, gag cameo and friend is one of them.
Rivalry exists only in the friendly Sunny Meadow Games (races, hopping contests, stone-skipping): Fiona against Taffy and Ben. It is always kind and always ends in high fives.
Family = Toto the baby bunny (Taffy's brother) and Grandma Nana the bear (Ben's grandma). They appear for cozy, soft moments.
The grown-ups are Grandpa Tilly the turtle (the wise elder) and Professor Ozzy the owl (the teacher at the schoolhouse). Stories may visit Ozzy's schoolhouse or ask Grandpa Tilly for wisdom.
The hero (usually Taffy) and their friend say their catchphrase when they rejoice, win, or finish something hard.
